characters.name: 老货车司机
characters.design: A 60-year-old retired long-haul truck driver, wearing a worn dark blue work jacket with faded company logo, gray work pants and scuffed leather boots, with gentle deep wrinkles on his weathered face, holding a yellowed cargo manifest, shot in medium shot with natural dawn light, muted desaturated tones matching the nostalgic realist style.

characters.name: 年轻货车徒弟
characters.design: A 25-year-old truck apprentice, wearing a clean dark work jacket, slim-fit work pants and clean work boots, with short neat hair and soft facial features, shot in medium shot with warm pre-dawn light, color grade consistent with the overall muted realist style.

issues: 设计要点要求 pre-dawn（黎明前）的温暖光线，画面呈现为傍晚/阴天环境光，缺乏温暖的黎明光线特征

props.name: 旧卡车钥匙
props.design: Worn brass heavy truck key with faded brand engraving, slightly tarnished surface, held between the old driver's calloused fingers, close-up shot with warm low-angle light highlighting the metal texture, muted desaturated tone matching the nostalgic style.

props.name: 重型货运卡车
props.design: Gritty well-used heavy-duty cargo truck with faded dark blue body, scuffed front grille and worn headlights, visible fine road dust on the body, shot in full side view with natural dawn light, muted desaturated color grade, realistic road movie texture.

issues: 设计要点要求 natural dawn light（自然晨光），画面中卡车前灯开启且天空阴沉，光线条件与晨光不符；车身蓝色饱和度较高，褪色感不明显

scenes.name: 清晨货运站
scenes.design: Dawn outdoor cargo yard with stacked cargo pallets, dim cool ambient light, distant city skyline silhouette, wet ground reflecting faint light, muted desaturated tones, natural documentary lighting, wide shot to show the overall atmosphere of the departure point.

issues: 设计要点要求 stacked cargo pallets（堆叠货物托盘），画面中为 shipping containers（集装箱），品类不符

scenes.name: 暴雨夜公路驾驶舱
scenes.design: Interior of heavy truck cabin at stormy night, rain droplets on the windshield, dim warm dashboard light illuminating the driver's hands on the steering wheel, high-contrast low-key lighting, cool blue undertones, close-up shot to highlight the driver's solitude.

issues: 设计要点要求 cool blue undertones（冷蓝色基调），画面整体偏暖（暖黄色仪表盘光），冷蓝基调缺失；设计要点要求 close-up shot（特写），画面为 medium shot（中景），可见驾驶员侧面及上半身，景别不符

scenes.name: 清晨山路交接点
scenes.design: Pre-dawn winding mountain roadside, soft warm amber sunrise light, distant valley mist, the old driver leaning against the truck door, muted desaturated tones with warm highlights, medium long shot to capture the emotional handover moment.
